headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS — HYDERABAD
key_facts: ~500 police personnel + pushing teams at choke points
metro 6 am-11 pm + special RTC buses beside 2,200 regular
bullets_en: Hyderabad Traffic Police issued a route plan for Khairatabad Bada Ganesh, with traffic diversions in place from Sept 12 to 24.
Around 500 police personnel, along with pushing teams, will be deployed at major traffic choke points, police said.
Metro will operate from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m. and special RTC buses will run in addition to 2,200 regular buses; devotees are urged to use public transport.
bullets_ur: Hyderabad Traffic Police ne Khairatabad Bada Ganesh ke liye route plan jaari kiya; 12 se 24 September tak traffic diversions rahenge.
Police ke mutabiq bare traffic choke points par taqreeban 500 police personnel aur pushing teams taianat rahengi.
Metro subah 6 se raat 11 baje tak chalegi aur 2,200 regular buses ke ilawa special RTC buses chalayi jayengi; devotees ko public transport ka mashwara diya gaya.
